task.title: Repair mutable bootstrap handling of generated tracked drift
task.phase: Supervisor Runtime / Source-only Mutable Bootstrap Repair

scope.owned_layer: Supervisor worker-context path selection and isolated-worktree task-brief materialization, plus mutable-bootstrap regression fixtures.
not_changing: Governed launch-source identity or byte capture
Mutable or immutable promotion cleanliness policy
Supervisor scheduling, task-state governance, provider policy, or fleet routing
Live config, process generations, runtime candidates, or deployment state

incident.original_failure: ValueError: Tracked git tree is dirty
incident.cause: Supervisor dispatch built execution context before leasing the isolated worker worktree. common.execution_context_files regenerated a task brief beside the mutable command source, overwriting a tracked task-brief blob and correctly tripping mutable-incumbent cleanliness validation.

decision.summary: Supervisor queue and request construction now describe repository-relative context paths without calling the materializing common helper. prepare_worker_workspace remains the write boundary: it copies a status-root brief when available or renders the fallback directly under the isolated task worktree.
decision.why_not_relax_promotion: The task-brief overwrite is preventable at its source. Keeping promotion unchanged preserves one simple invariant: every tracked or staged difference from HEAD remains fatal, including task briefs and all governed launch sources.

implementation.worker_execution_context_files: Purely returns AI_COLLABORATION_GUIDE.md, the normalized task-brief destination, both worker process skills when present, and ai-status.json; it performs no status read or file write.
implementation.queue_delivery_event: Supervisor-local wrapper seeds the pure context list before delegating to watch_events, preventing watch_events from falling back to its materializing common helper.
implementation.build_request: Direct or replayed queue records that omit context_files use the same pure list, closing the non-wrapper request path.
implementation.materialize_worker_context_files: Unchanged write boundary; destinations remain under request.metadata.workspace_path in an isolated task worktree.

regressions.proof: A pre-existing command-root task brief remains byte-identical while process_queue builds the worker request.
The supervisor wrapper supplies the complete relative context list before the legacy queue renderer can materialize anything.
When no status-root brief exists, canonical task fields are rendered below the isolated workspace and no command/status-root task brief is created.
A linked worktree with a regular .git gitfile and exactly one unstaged tracked task-brief overwrite reproduces the incident and still fails closed with Tracked git tree is dirty.

validation.coverage: Immutable candidate guard, mutable gitfile binding, config CAS, transaction lock/order, rollback, evidence location, and bytecode self-rejection all remain green.

validation.baseline_variance: The two failures are unchanged origin/dev RuntimeConfigTests expectations that Antigravity2 is disabled with workload 0, while origin/dev config enables it with workload 6. This task changes neither .orchestrator/config.json nor the failing assertions and does not take over fleet-policy repair.

validation.result: empty; promotion policy and runtime config are byte-unchanged by this task

required_checks: Confirm queue and build paths cannot call common.execution_context_files when context_files is absent.
Confirm missing task briefs are still materialized only below the isolated workspace path.
Confirm scripts/promote_supervisor_runtime.py is absent from the task diff and the exact tracked task-brief reproduction remains fail-closed.
Confirm no live rollout, config mutation, scheduling change, or fleet-routing change is present.

rollout.next: Any runtime promotion or rollout retry requires a separately authorized governed task after this source change is merged.

rollback.source: Revert the reviewed task PR if worker context is not materialized in isolated task worktrees.
rollback.live: Not applicable; this task performs no live mutation.
